name: Shared Folders (SMB/NFS)
description: File sharing service: mounts and serves network folders across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
capabilities: \\SERVER-IP\condivisa from Windows File Explorer, smb://IP/condivisa from Mac and Linux
Subfolders: 01 Documents, 02 Websites, 03 3D models, 04 Code, 05 Exchange, 06 Music
Access only with the nuxiva-share user and password, Windows 11 compatible (SMB2/3)
Personal memory stays on the server, never on the network
Read-only mode, allowed networks, network recycle bin, SMB protocol and encryption of your choice
Live connected sessions and upload limit from the panel

settings.NUXIVA_SMB_PASSWORD: Password of the nuxiva-share user (empty = generated)
settings.NUXIVA_SHARES_NETWORKS: Allowed networks (prefixes, IPs or CIDR separated by spaces; empty = home networks)
settings.NUXIVA_SHARES_RECYCLE: Network recycle bin (deleted files can be recovered)
